camel_example: aliyun cloudauth BankMetaVerify --region cn-hangzhou --VerifyMode VERIFY_BANK_CARD --IdentityType 01 --UserName '张0' --IdentifyNum 429001000000008211 --ProductType BANK_CARD_2_META --Mobile 13800000011 --ParamType normal --BankCard 61000000000000001181
description_en: Provides API operations for bank card element verification, including two-element, three-element, and four-element verification
description_zh: 银行卡要素（银行卡二要素、银行卡三要素和银行卡四要素）API接口
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth bank-meta-verify --param-type normal --verify-mode VERIFY_BANK_CARD --product-type BANK_CARD_2_META --user-name '张0' --identify-num 429001000000008211 --bank-card 61000000000000001181 --mobile 13800000011 --identity-type 01 --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BankMetaVerify

parameters.help_en:
The parameter type. Valid values:

normal: not encrypted.
md5: MD5-encrypted
parameters.help_zh:
参数类型：

normal：不加密。
md5：MD5加密
parameters.name: param_type

parameters.help_en: VERIFY_BANK_CARD: bank card verification mode. Specifies whether the provided bank card number matches the real name, ID card number, and phone number of the user
parameters.help_zh: VERIFY_BANK_CARD：银行卡认证模式。表示将传入的银行卡号和用户的真实姓名、身份证号，手机号是否匹配
parameters.name: verify_mode

parameters.help_en:
The product type. Valid values:

BANK_CARD_2_META: bank card number + name verification.
BANK_CARD_3_META: bank card number + name + ID card number verification.
BANK_CARD_4_META: bank card number + name + ID card number + phone number verification
parameters.help_zh:
调用产品类型：

BANK_CARD_2_META：银⾏卡号+姓名核验。
BANK_CARD_3_META：银⾏卡号+姓名+身份证号核验。
BANK_CARD_4_META：银⾏卡号+姓名+身份证号+⼿机号核验
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en:
The name.

If paramType is set to normal, enter the name in plaintext.
If paramType is set to md5, enter the MD5 hash (32-bit lowercase) of the first character of the name + the remaining characters of the name in plaintext
parameters.help_zh:
姓名。

当paramType取值normal时，输入姓名明文。
当paramType取值md5时，姓名第一个字MD5加密（32位小写MD5）+ 姓名其他部分明文
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID card number.

This parameter is required if ProductType is set to BANK_CARD_3_META.
If paramType is set to normal, enter the ID card number in plaintext.
If paramType is set to md5, enter the first 6 digits of the ID card number in plaintext + the MD5 hash (32-bit lowercase) of the date of birth + the last 4 digits of the ID card number
parameters.help_zh:
身份证号。

当ProductType取值BANK_CARD_3_META时，此项必选。
当paramType取值normal时，输入身份证号明文。
当paramType取值md5时，身份证号前6位明文+出生年月日md5加密（32位小写MD5）+身份证号后4位
parameters.name: identify_num

parameters.help_en:
The bank card number.

If paramType is set to normal, enter the bank card number in plaintext.
If paramType is set to md5, enter the card number excluding the last 6 digits in plaintext + the MD5 hash (32-bit lowercase) of the last 6 digits
parameters.help_zh:
银行卡号。

当paramType取值normal时，输入银行卡号明文。
当paramType取值md5时，卡号除最后6位其他部分明文+最后6位md5值（32位小写）
parameters.name: bank_card

parameters.help_en:
The phone number.

This parameter is required if ProductType is set to BANK_CARD_4_META.
If paramType is set to normal, enter the phone number in plaintext.
If paramType is set to md5, enter the MD5 hash (32-bit lowercase) of the phone number
parameters.help_zh:
手机号。

当ProductType取值BANK_CARD_4_META时，此项必选。
当paramType取值normal时，输入手机号明文。
当paramType取值md5时，输入手机号（32位小写MD5）
parameters.name: mobile
